<thought>Using the ESI‑MS spectrum, the most intense ion is at m/z 127.0997, which corresponds to the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the mass of a proton gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈126.0924 Da. By searching plausible combinations of C, H, O and one additional heteroatom, the formula C₇H₁₂NO matches this mass within a few ppm (exact mass 126.091889 Da). Therefore the molecular formula is C7H12NO.</thought>
<final_answer>C7H12NO</final_answer>
